experiment_name: Davao Food Finder Controlled Temporal & Counterfactual Data Volatility Benchmark
methodology_note: Evaluates Objective 1 (Data Volatility Resilience) by comparing Static 2025 CSV Baseline, Stale 12h+ Cached Snapshots (pre-change state), Single-Pass Ablation with Fresh Evidence, and Full Agentic Iterative Loop with Fresh Evidence across 15 real Davao City store scenarios.
